manifest.name: dsh-notify-windows
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：任务完成 / 等待审批 / 等待回答时发送 Windows 系统桌面通知

bundle.text:
# dsh-notify-windows bundle patch.
#
# Declares the plugin's single loader entry. The `insert:` rows live in the
# package's own patch file, so `dsh plugin add dsh-notify-windows` auto-mounts
# the entry — no manual `- insert:` in the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
# The `name` (a bare package specifier) resolves to this package's
# `main`/`exports["."]` (lib/index.js) via the loader's two-anchor resolution
# (dsh install first, then the profile's node_modules).
#
# Install: dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-notify-windows
# Restart `dsh --profile <name>` after installing.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-notify
      name: dsh-notify-windows

readme.text: <div align="center">

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：当 Agent 需要你关注时，向 Windows 发送系统桌面通知** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-windows) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-windows) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-notify-windows/releases) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-notify-windows) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) **任务完成** ✅ ｜ **等待审批** 🔐 ｜ **等待回答** ❓ —— 离开屏幕也不错过任何需要你处理的事。 ---

- **任务完成提醒**：监听会话 `turn/end` 事件，任务完成 / 出错 / 输出超限时立即弹窗，标题自动使用会话标题，正文显示原因与轮次；
- **权限审批提醒**：监听 `approval/asked` 事件，有操作等待你的审批时立即提醒；会话审批策略为 `never` 时自动跳过（此时没有东西在等你）；
- **提问确认提醒**：Agent 调用 `ask_user_question` 向你提问时提醒；本部署下所有工具都经 `run_code` 调用，插件会扫描 `run_code` 程序源码中的 `tools.ask_user_question(` 调用并提取问题文本；
- **防打扰**：默认忽略子代理（subagent）会话，只提醒主会话；
- **零依赖**：通知通过 Windows PowerShell 5.1 的 WinRT Toast API 发送，自动注册 HKCU 的 AppUserModelId（无需管理员权限）；
- **可诊断**：可选日志（`%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log`）与 debug 事件日志。

项目通过 **`dsh.bundle`** 机制安装：npm 包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会在
`dsh plugin add` 后自动挂载 `dsh-notify` 入口，**不需要**再手动 `- insert:`。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-windows
```

重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器后生效：

```powershell
dsh --profile web
```

> 注意：不要再用 `- insert:` 手动添加 `dsh-notify`，否则启动会报
> `duplicate loader entry id: dsh-notify`。想调整配置，在 profile 的
> `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖即可（见下节）。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-notify-windows
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-notify-windows
```

更新后需重启 DSH 宿主（新增 bundle 层需要重新启动）。

插件行 `config` 全字段可选，未填按默认值。需要调整时，在
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖主条目即可
（该文件被运行中的 DSH 热监视，改动立即生效，无需重启）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  name: dsh-notify-windows
  config:
    enabled: true

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `reasons` | `[completed, error, max-tokens]` | 需要提醒的回合结束原因（可选 `aborted` / `interrupted` / `blocked`） |
| `locale` | `zh` | toast 文案的内置语言包：`zh` / `en` / `ru` |
| `messages` | `{}` | 按 key 覆盖文案，优先级高于 `locale`（见「多语言」） |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | 是否也提醒子代理会话 |
| `notifyOnStart` | `false` | 插件加载时发一条「已激活」通知 |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | 审批请求提醒（策略 `never` 时自动跳过） |
| `notifyOnAskUser` | `true` | Agent 提问等待回答时提醒 |
| `notifyOnGoalRounds` | `false` | /goal 自动推进回合不提醒（目标完成/阻塞的最终回合除外） |
| `excerpt` | `true` | 通知正文附带 Agent 最后回复的摘要 |
| `excerptMaxChars` | `80` | 摘要最大字符数 |
| `appName` | `DeepSeek Harness` | 通知来源显示名与兜底标题 |
| `aumid` | `DeepSeekHarness.Notify` | 通知 AppUserModelId |
| `log` | `true` | 写日志到 `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` |
| `debug` | `false` | 把所有会话事件写入日志（排查用，量大） |
| `openOnClick` | `true` | 任务完成 / 审批 / 提问 toast 是否可点击（false 回退为旧的无点击 toast） |
| `preferExisting` | `true` | true 走 launcher 优先聚焦已开 DSH 窗口；false 直接用默认浏览器打开 URL |
| `webUrl` | `''` | 覆盖自动发现的基地址（如 `http://192.168.1.5:4000`），留空自动发现（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`） |

toast 文案取自内置语言包，由 `locale` 选择。默认 `zh`，因此已有安装升级后文案完全不变；
`en` 与 `ru` 为完整语言包。任何一条文案都可以用 `messages` 按 key 覆盖，覆盖优先于语言包：

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  name: dsh-notify-windows
  config:
    locale: ru

| key | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` / `error` / `max-tokens` / `aborted` / `interrupted` / `blocked` | 回合结束原因行（按 `reason.kind` 查表） |
| `turnEnded` | 原因在语言包中没有对应条目时的兜底文案 |
| `turnSuffix` | 追加在原因行后的轮次后缀 —— `{turn}` |
| `approvalTitle` | 审批通知的标题后缀 |
| `approvalToolWithReason` / `approvalTool` / `approvalGeneric` | 审批正文 —— `{tool}` / `{reason}` |
| `askTitle` | 提问通知的标题后缀 |
| `askFallback` | 提取不到问题文本时的提问正文 |
| `activated` | `notifyOnStart` 的「已激活」通知 —— `{version}` |
| `warnSpawnFailed` / `warnToastFailed` / `warnExitCode` / `warnChannelUnavailable` | DSH 日志文案 —— `{code}`；`dsh-notify:` 前缀不翻译，保证跨语言可 grep |

说明：`{占位符}` 由事件数据代入；未知占位符**原样保留**（不会被清空），非字符串的覆盖值会被忽略，
因此写错不会产生空正文或 `[object Object]`；未知 `locale` 回退默认语言包。

审批 / 提问路径的日志行新增 `title` 与 `body` 字段（与 `notify` 行一致），
`%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` 因此能直接看到实际发出的文案。

| 场景 | 会话事件 | 通知示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 任务完成 | `turn/end` | 「任务已完成（第 N 轮）」 |
| 任务出错 / 超限 | `turn/end` | 「任务出错」/「输出达到 token 上限」 |
| 等待审批 | `approval/asked` | 「DeepSeek Harness · 需要审批 / 工具 pwsh：…」 |
| 等待回答 | `tool/call`（含 run_code 检测） | 「DeepSeek Harness · 需要回答 / 是否继续？」 |

readme.section: 🔗 点击通知跳转 / Click to Open
readme.text:
任务完成 / 等待审批 / 等待回答的 toast 可点击 → 打开 DSH Web GUI。优先聚焦已打开的
DSH 浏览器标签或 Chrome Application 窗口；没有已开窗口时在默认浏览器新开标签并打开 GUI。
目标 URL 带 `?session=<id>` 参数（rc.8 前端暂不消费，为未来深链预留）。

**配置：**

- `openOnClick`（默认 `true`，`false` 则关闭可点击，回退为旧的无点击 toast）；
- `preferExisting`（默认 `true`，`true` 走 launcher 优先复用已开窗口；`false` 直接用默认浏览器打开 URL）；
- `webUrl`（可选，覆盖自动发现的基地址，如 `http://192.168.1.5:4000`，留空自动发现 / 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）。

**注意事项：** 首次点击会自动注册 `dshnotify://` 协议处理器（HKCU，无需管理员）；故障会静默降级为「默认浏览器打开」。

readme.text: > 说明：DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 前端暂不支持按 URL 直达单个会话；点击后打开的是 DSH 界面（首页/会话列表）并聚焦已有窗口，目标会话需在列表中选择。未来 DSH 前端支持深链后 `?session=<id>` 将直接定位。

DSH 0.2.1 起兼容门禁优先读取 `engines.dsh`。本插件声明 **`engines.dsh: ">=0.1.5-rc.1"`**（无上限；旧版 DSH 在未声明该字段时沿用 peer 规则），并已核对：

| DSH 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.5-rc.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.7-rc.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.2.0-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ 兼容门禁 + 单测通过 |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ 兼容门禁通过 |

> 只列出**实际跑过**的版本；未实测的不列。

v0.8.1 支持 DSH **0.1.2-alpha.4+**，已在 **0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1** 上核对 `snapshotEvents()` 契约；在 **0.2.1-rc.1** 上通过兼容门禁与 20 项单测，0.2.1-rc.2 门禁通过。历史读取同时兼容旧版 `session.events`（DSH ≤ 0.1.2-alpha.3）与新版 `snapshotEvents()`（DSH 0.1.2-alpha.4 起该属性已不存在），升级到 0.7.5 后摘要 / `/goal` 轮次 / 审批策略恢复正常。收到过「重启后所有通知静默」问题的请升级到 **0.7.3+**（见 FAQ）。
> **0.1.7-rc.1 说明**：该版本起 `snapshotEvents()` 被标记为 `@deprecated`（"新调用被禁止，现有未迁移逻辑可暂时保留"）。本插件的历史读取属既有逻辑，按官方 Agent Note 的延期口径暂不迁移——DSH 仍在内存保留完整事件序列，通知摘要与 `/goal` 轮次检查照常工作；待 DSH 提供异步分页读取替代后再迁移。

```powershell
node scripts\smoke-test.mjs
```

独立进程内用 cordis Context 模拟会话事件：应弹出任务完成 / 审批 / 提问三条测试通知，并断言日志记录与过滤行为（子代理、`never` 策略、无关调用均被过滤）。

- **收不到通知？** 检查 Windows「通知与操作」设置是否允许该应用显示通知，以及「专注助手」是否开启；首次发送会自动注册 AUMID。插件启动时会自检通知通道（`powershell.exe` 与 `notify.ps1` 是否可达），通道不可用会在 DSH 日志中立即告警；每次发送失败也会记录详细原因到 `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log`。
- **WSL 下收不到通知？** 插件会自动用 `wslpath -w` 把脚本路径转成 `\\wsl.localhost\...` UNC 路径，并优先通过 `/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe` 调用 PowerShell（不依赖 PATH，systemd / cron 等最小环境也能工作）。若仍失败，查看 `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` 中的 `error` 条目。
- **/goal 模式会提醒吗？** 默认不会：自动推进的中间回合保持静默，只有目标完成（或阻塞）的最终回合才提醒；如需每个回合都提醒，把 `notifyOnGoalRounds` 设为 `true`。
- **为什么审批提醒有时不弹？** 会话审批策略为 `never` 时审批会被自动拒绝、不会等待，插件会跳过提醒；策略为 `ask` 时才提醒。
- **重启 DSH 后所有通知都没了？** 这是 **0.7.2 及更早**的已知缺陷：子代理判定当时写作 `delegationDepth !== undefined`，会把每次 `dsh web` 重启后带 `delegationDepth: 0` 的**主会话**误判为子代理并静默过滤。该缺陷已在 **0.7.3** 修复（判定改为 `(delegationDepth ?? 0) > 0`）：请把插件升级到 **0.7.3 及以上**（推荐 0.7.5），执行 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-notify-windows` 后重启 DSH 宿主。
- **通知摘要变空、`/goal` 中间回合开始提醒、`never` 策略仍提醒？** 插件读取的 `session.events` 属性**自 DSH 0.1.2-alpha.4 起就不存在**（历史读取改为 `snapshotEvents()`；0.1.2-alpha.3 及更早才有该属性），**0.7.4 及更早**读取该属性会拿到 `undefined` 后静默降级，出现上述三种症状。**请升级到 0.7.5 及以上**（历史读取已同时兼容两种 API；若升级后 `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` 仍出现 `histor

**A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that sends Windows desktop notifications whenever the agent needs your attention** [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-windows) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-windows) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-notify-windows/releases) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-notify-windows) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**Task finished** ✅ ｜ **Approval pending** 🔐 ｜ **Question pending** ❓ — never miss anything that needs you, even away from the screen.

---

The plugin installs through the **`dsh.bundle`** mechanism: the npm package ships its own
`cordis.patch.yml`, and after `dsh plugin add` it auto-mounts the `dsh-notify` entry — no
manual `- insert:` needed.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-windows
```

Restart DSH and refresh the browser:

```powershell
dsh --profile web
```

> Note: don't hand-add `- insert:` with `dsh-notify` anymore — DSH would fail to boot with
> `duplicate loader entry id: dsh-notify`. To tweak settings, override the entry by id in the
> profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (see below).

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-notify-windows
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-notify-windows
```

Restart the DSH host after updating (a newly added bundle layer needs a boot).

All `config` keys are optional and default in the plugin. To override, target the entry by id
in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (hot-applied by the running host — no restart):

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  name: dsh-notify-windows
  config:
    enabled: true

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `reasons` | `[completed, error, max-tokens]` | turn-end reasons to notify (`aborted` / `interrupted` / `blocked` also available) |
| `locale` | `zh` | built-in message pack for the toast text: `zh` / `en` / `ru` |
| `messages` | `{}` | per-key wording overrides applied on top of `locale` (see Localization) |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | also notify subagent sessions |
| `notifyOnStart` | `false` | toast when the plugin loads |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | toast on `approval/asked` (skipped under policy `never`) |
| `notifyOnAskUser` | `true` | toast when the agent asks you a question |
| `notifyOnGoalRounds` | `false` | stay quiet on /goal auto-continuation rounds (except the final complete/block round) |
| `excerpt` | `true` | append an excerpt of the agent's final reply to the toast |
| `excerptMaxChars` | `80` | max characters of the excerpt |
| `appName` | `DeepSeek Harness` | toast source display name and fallback title |
| `aumid` | `DeepSeekHarness.Notify` | toast AppUserModelId |
| `log` | `true` | write `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` |
| `debug` | `false` | log every session eve

Toast wording comes from a built-in message pack selected by `locale`. The default is `zh`, so an
existing install sees no change after upgrading; `en` and `ru` ship as complete packs. Any single
string can be overridden per install through `messages`, which wins over the selected pack:

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  name: dsh-notify-windows
  config:
    locale: ru

| Key | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` / `error` / `max-tokens` / `aborted` / `interrupted` / `blocked` | the turn/end reason line (looked up by `reason.kind`) |
| `turnEnded` | fallback when a reason has no entry in the pack |
| `turnSuffix` | turn number appended to the reason line — `{turn}` |
| `approvalTitle` | title suffix of an approval toast |
| `approvalToolWithReason` / `approvalTool` / `approvalGeneric` | approval body — `{tool}`, `{reason}` |
| `askTitle` | title suffix of a question toast |
| `askFallback` | question body when no question text could be extracted |
| `activated` | the `notifyOnStart` toast — `{version}` |
| `warnSpawnFailed` / `warnToastFailed` / `warnExitCode` / `warnChannelUnavailable` | DSH log wording — `{code}`; the `dsh-notify:` tag itself is never translated, so logs stay greppable across locales |

`{placeholder}` tokens are substituted from the event data. An unknown placeholder is left verbatim
rather than blanked, and a non-string override is ignored — a typo can therefore never produce an
empty or `[object Object]` toast. An unknown `locale` falls back to the default pack.

The `approval` and `ask-user` log entries now carry `title` and `body` alongside the existing
metadata (matching what the `notify` entry already did), so `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log` shows
the text that was actually sent.

| Scenario | Session event | Sample toast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task finished | `turn/end` | Task completed (turn N) |
| Task errored / capped | `turn/end` | Task errored / Output hit token cap |
| Approval waiting | `approval/asked` | DeepSeek Harness · Needs approval / tool pwsh: … |
| Question waiting | `tool/call` (incl. run_code detection) | DeepSeek Harness · Needs your answer / Continue? |

readme.section: 🔗 点击通知跳转 / Click to Open
readme.text:
Toasts for task completion / approval pending / question pending are clickable → they open the
DSH Web GUI. The plugin prefers to focus an already-open DSH browser tab or Chrome Application
window; if none is open, it opens a new tab in the default browser and loads the GUI. The target
URL carries a `?session=<id>` parameter (not yet consumed by the rc.8 frontend — reserved for
future deep links).

readme.section: 🔗 点击通知跳转 / Click to Open
🔗 点击通知跳转 / Click to Open
readme.text:
**Notes:** the first click auto-registers the `dshnotify://` protocol handler (HKCU, no admin
needed); on failure it silently degrades to "open in default browser".

> Note: DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 does not yet support deep-linking to a single session by URL; clicking opens the DSH interface (home / session list) and focuses the existing window, and you pick the target session from the list. Once the DSH frontend supports deep links, `?session=<id>` will jump straight to it.

Since DSH 0.2.1 the compatibility gate prefers `engines.dsh`. This plugin declares **`engines.dsh: ">=0.1.5-rc.1"`** (no upper bound; older DSH falls back to peer rules when the field is absent) and has been checked on:

| DSH version | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.5-rc.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.7-rc.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.2.0-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ Gate + unit tests |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ Gate |
> Only versions that were **actually run** are listed; untested versions are omitted.

v0.8.1 supports DSH **0.1.2-alpha.4+** and was verified against the `snapshotEvents()` contract on **0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1**; on **0.2.1-rc.1** it passes the compatibility gate and 20 unit tests, and **0.2.1-rc.2** passes the gate. Session history is read through both the legacy `session.events` (DSH <= 0.1.2-alpha.3) and `snapshotEvents()` (DSH 0.1.2-alpha.4+, where that property no longer exists), so excerpts, `/goal` round detection and approval-policy suppression work again after upgrading to 0.7.5. If you saw "all notifications went silent after a restart", upgrade to **0.7.3+** (see FAQ).

> **0.1.7-rc.1 note**: since this release `snapshotEvents()` is marked `@deprecated` ("new calls forbidden; existing unmigrated logic may stay for now"). This plugin's history read is such existing logic, so under the official Agent Note's deferral policy it is not migrated yet — DSH still keeps the full event sequence in memory, so notification excerpts and `/goal` round checks keep working; migration will follow once DSH offers an asynchronous paged read.

```powershell
node scripts\smoke-test.mjs
```

Runs the plugin on a bare cordis Context with synthetic events: three test toasts fire (completion, approval, question) and the log assertions verify the filtering (subagent, `never`-policy, unrelated calls).

- **No toast?** Check Windows notification settings for this app and Focus Assist; the AUMID registers itself on first use. On startup the plugin self-checks the notification channel (`powershell.exe` and `notify.ps1` reachable) and warns immediately in the DSH log if it is unavailable; each failed send also records the detailed reason in `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log`.
- **No toast under WSL?** The plugin uses `wslpath -w` to convert the script path to a `\\wsl.localhost\...` UNC path and prefers `/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe` to invoke PowerShell (PATH-independent, so it works in minimal environments such as systemd / cron). If it still fails, check the `error` entries in `%TEMP%\dsh-notify\notify.log`.
- **Do /goal rounds toast?** Not by default: auto-continuation rounds stay quiet and only the final round that completes (or blocks) the goal toasts. Set `notifyOnGoalRounds` to `true` to hear every round.
- **Approval toasts missing?** Sessions whose approval policy is `never` auto-reject — nothing waits, so the plugin stays quiet. Only `ask`-policy sessions notify.
